cluster_fsid.description: The globally unique cluster identifier (UUID). Must be identical on all nodes.

items.description: A monitor (MON) node address (IP or hostname), optionally with port (default 6789).

mon_hosts.description: List of monitor addresses used by OSDs to discover the cluster.

public_network.description: CIDR notation of the public (client-facing) network for the Ceph cluster.

cluster_network.description: CIDR notation of the cluster (replication/internal) network. Separate from public for production.

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication required for cluster communication (mon-daemon ↔ mon-daemon, osd-daemon ↔ mon-daemon).

auth_service_required.description: Authentication required for service communication (rbd-mirror, etc.).

auth_client_required.description: Authentication required for client connections (e.g., via CephFS, RBD, S3).

log_file.description: Path to the main OSD log file. Use empty string to disable file logging.

osd_journal_size.description: Size (in MiB) of the journal for non-journal-devices (legacy filestore). Ignored for bluestore.

osd_max_backfills.description: Maximum number of concurrent backfill operations per OSD. Reduce under heavy load.

osd_recovery_max_active.description: Maximum number of concurrent recovery (backfill/recovery) objects per OSD.

id.description: OSD ID (non-negative integer). Must be unique within the cluster.

data_path.description: Path to the OSD data directory (filestore) or device (bluestore, e.g., /dev/sdb1 or /dev/disk/by-id/...).

has_journal.description: Whether to include a dedicated journal device for this OSD (legacy filestore).

journal_path.description: Path to journal file or device (ignored for bluestore or when has_journal is false).

has_wal.description: Whether to use a separate WAL device (e.g., for high-performance NVMe).

wal_path.description: Path to WAL device or file.

host_name.description: Custom host name for CRUSH placement (overrides default hostname).

device_class.description: CRUSH device class (e.g., 'hdd', 'ssd', 'nvme') — used for tiering and rules.

osds.description: List of OSD configurations. Each entry defines an OSD and its storage layout.
